steps.name: Accept fixture data notice
steps.goal: Tap Agree and continue on the Your data and AI providers screen for this isolated demo fixture. Wait for Home. Do not tap the root element named omg.

steps.name: Open the long session
steps.goal: On Home, tap the api-gateway folder chip in the project rail. Then open the conversation titled Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window. Do not type a message.
steps.done: The conversation screen is open at its newest message, with the idle reading check line.

steps.name: Older reply survives a live refresh
steps.goal: Do not tap or swipe anything. Wait until the reading check line says passed, failed or empty.
steps.done: The older page and the subsequent live refresh have landed. The reading check passes and History message 093 remains visible.

steps.done: The reading check line says passed or empty.
